title: Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents
why_relevant: Proposes a risk-sensitive contextual bandit controller that decides whether to inject retrieved memory, abstain, ask for feedback, or skip retrieval, with explicit false-positive penalties. Directly addresses when-to-retrieve/trust and abstention in an agentic RAG-like memory setting.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain is narrow (coding-agent issue memory) and evaluation is small-scale, deterministic proxy rather than full RAG benchmarks.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: when to retrieve and abstain
